name: operate
description: Plan, dispatch, execute, govern decisions, and independently verify human and AI-agent work in Operate.

interface.shortDescription: Run projects with humans and AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Compile briefs into auditable roadmaps, route dependency-ready work to capable agents, preserve versioned operating decisions with task revalidation, execute through claims and runs, and independently verify original success criteria against evidence from one control plane.
defaultPrompt: Turn this confirmed brief into an auditable multi-project execution plan in Operate.
Show me the next safe execution wave and explain any capability or capacity gaps.
Monitor this execution plan and summarize running, failed, retryable, and completed work.
Verify this plan's original success criteria with independent evidence review.
